about: Public lists of addresses for 'feed <name> <action>' (proposal 0025). No list is shipped: each site fetches them itself (bin/request-shield feeds <main.rules> update) under the list's own terms -- read them before using a list. 'every': the shortest time between two fetches; 'wideOk': ranges wider than /16 (IPv4) or /32 (IPv6) are kept (otherwise dropped); 'suggested': the action the list is good for.
